_comment: Copy into the project as brand.json. Every key is optional; anything missing falls back to the template defaults. Colours are hex. Logo paths are relative to the project root; font overrides are font filenames, looked up in the OS's font folders (~/Library/Fonts, %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Fonts, ~/.local/share/fonts, and the system ones), or a path relative to the project root.

narrator._comment: ElevenLabs voice_id per language, used by video-edit tts.py

voice.register: second person, present tense, no exclamation marks
must_carry: brand name in the URL line
